{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Many Democrats believe the federal government has a right to claim money earned by working Americans.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats fight any attempt to return the balance of power from Washington to individual families and businesses.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All of the tax relief provided over the last four years will be eliminated in the next six years if Congress does not take action to make the relief permanent.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party endorses the President's proposals to make tax relief permanent, so that families and businesses can plan for the future with confidence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Anything less than making the tax relief permanent will result in a significant tax increase on Americans.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Making the tax cuts permanent is a crucial first step toward expanding ownership and ensuring that America turns economic growth into lasting prosperity.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The only way to accomplish the goal of making tax cuts permanent is to elect a solid Republican majority to both houses of Congress.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party looks forward to a new Congress with larger Republican majorities working with President Bush to ensure that taxes do not go back up on American families.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
